name: network-scan-360
intent: A 360° phosphor sweep wires five nodes at 0/72/144/216/288° on 150ms discovery steps.
acceptance: Sweep discovers nodes at anglesDeg [0,72,144,216,288] in order at stepMs 150
Links activate with nodes; inventory complete only after node 5 + settleMs 100
Replay deactivates all five nodes/links before rerunning
Reduced motion shows all five nodes mapped immediately
